title: The game heap is a fixed 11 MiB from the build: with 128 MB of RAM Vivec still runs under the 2 MiB safety gap and loads pause
status: Fixed in v0.0.45 (branch v0.0.43-prefetch, merged in the v0.0.45 line): the heap is sized at start from the largest free Fast RAM block less CHIM margin (2 MiB + an eighth), grown by a quarter of the room beyond the built 11 MiB when that room holds it plus 8 MiB, at most 24 MiB; -heapmb as asked, aw_autoram 0 keeps the built size. FS-UAE, dev2 data, 128 MiB: a 24 MiB heap and an 82 MiB CHIM cache; no hunk-gap safety warning in 5 laps of Balmora, Caldera, Vivec and Seyda Neen (dev2 as built: 4 warnings on one open-world route); 16 MiB keeps 11 MiB.
where: engine heap size (sys_amiga.c Sys_Init); Vivec city warns 'hunk-gap safety below 2 MiB'
severity_reason: players with more RAM get no benefit: memory warnings and load pauses that spare RAM could avoid
